rationale: The gap-up opened at its high ($8.07) and has been fading on steadily declining 1m volume (272K→96K), a bearish distribution structure — but price has reclaimed VWAP ($7.93) and is ticking above the last few minutes' range right now, which argues against shorting into immediate strength. With no news, no float data (squeeze risk unknown), only ~6 minutes of session evidence, and a risk-off tape cutting both ways, neither direction offers a clean entry with valid invalidation; waiting for either rejection at the highs or a VWAP break is the higher-expectancy action.
